ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The macro-level ratio exhibits a high-intensity (white) dominance covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized along the trailing margins and the central longitudinal axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity white contiguous zones; a low-intensity black perimeter border along the trailing edge; a low-intensity vertical band at the central peduncle-fluke junction; discrete low-intensity circular spots distributed on the medial-ventral surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees; bounding-box depth is relatively small compared to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile along the continuous trailing boundary; maximum pixel-amplitude variations are concentrated at the distal lateral tips; serrations appear as jagged, multi-directional peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted from the median notch extending to the distal lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels on the distal lateral tips; approximately 5-7 discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters (4-8 pixels in diameter) localized on the white ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible epibiotic colonization (barnacles) on both distal fluke tips; irregular dark pigmentation spots on the inner white surface.
